preconditions.description: n is the number of vertices (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5), and m is the number of edges with weight 1 (0 ≤ m ≤ min(n(n-1)/2, 10^5)).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (a_i, b_i) has distinct endpoints within the vertex range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len(set((min(a_i, b_i), max(a_i, b_i)) for a_i, b_i in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: No edge appears twice in the input (all edges are unique).

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(n - 1 - (m - (n - 1 - c))) if (c := m - (n - 1)) >= 0 else str(n - 1)
postconditions.description: The output is the weight of the minimum spanning tree (MST). If m ≥ n-1, the MST weight is (n-1) - (m - (n-1)) = 2(n-1) - m. Otherwise, the MST weight is n-1 (all edges in MST are weight 0).
